title: Activity Recognition from Smart Insole Sensor Data Using a Circular Dilated CNN
abstract: arXiv:2603.04477v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Smart insoles equipped with pressure sensors, accelerometers, and gyroscopes offer a non-intrusive way of monitoring human gait and posture. We present an activity classification system based on a circular dilated convolutional neural network (CDCNN) that processes multi-modal time-series data from such insoles. The model operates on 160-frame windows with 24 channels (18 pressure, 3 accelerometer, 3 gyroscope axes), achieving 86.42% test accuracy in a subject-independent evaluation on a four-class task (Standing, Walking, Sitting, Tandem). Permutation feature importance reveals the distribution of contributions made by various sensors to the classification process. The proposed approach has potential applications in areas such as smart insole design, health monitoring, and rehabilitation.

translated_title: 基于循环扩张卷积神经网络的智能鞋垫传感器数据活动识别
translated_abstract: 配备压力传感器、加速度计和陀螺仪的智能鞋垫提供了一种非侵入式的人体步态和姿势监测方式。我们提出了一种基于循环扩张卷积神经网络（CDCNN）的活动分类系统，该系统处理来自此类鞋垫的多模态时间序列数据。该模型在160帧窗口上运行，包含24个通道（18个压力通道、3个加速度计轴、3个陀螺仪轴），在四分类任务（站立、行走、坐着、串联站立）的受试者独立评估中达到了86.42%的测试准确率。排列特征重要性分析揭示了各种传感器对分类过程贡献的分布情况。所提出的方法在智能鞋垫设计、健康监测和康复等领域具有潜在应用价值。
tldr: 提出一种循环扩张卷积神经网络（CDCNN）来处理智能鞋垫的多模态传感器数据，在受试者独立的四类活动识别任务中达到86.42%的测试准确率，并通过特征重要性分析揭示了不同传感器的贡献。
en_tdlr: A circular dilated convolutional neural network (CDCNN) is proposed to process multi-modal smart insole sensor data, achieving 86.42% test accuracy in subject-independent four-class activity recognition, with permutation feature importance revealing sensor contributions.
